'''Premiere to Virtual Set 3''' is a constructed environment used for the [[2025 Online Retro Event for Charity]]: printed Decipher cards plus Virtual Sets through [[Virtual Set 3]]. The name is the Players Committee's.<ref name="pc-charity25" />

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee (2025)
* '''Card pool:''' Decipher cards plus Virtual Sets through Virtual Set 3
* '''In use:''' 2025
* '''GEMP:''' none under this name; see [[Premiere - Virtual Set 3]]

== Card pool ==
The event used printed Decipher cards plus Virtual Sets through [[Virtual Set 3]].<ref name="pc-charity25" /> It differs from [[Premiere - Death Star II]], which has no current virtual cards, and from [[Open]], the full current virtual pool. It is also not [[Premiere - Original VS3]], the 2002 original Virtual Set 1&ndash;3 slips.

GEMP has a constructed format, [[Premiere - Virtual Set 3]] (<code>premiere_set3</code>), with every Decipher card, current Virtual Sets 0&ndash;3, the Virtual Premium Set and 12 later virtual Defensive Shields.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="pc-gemp" /> The event sources on this wiki do not say whether the event used that format or what deck rules it had.

== History ==
The Players Committee ran the [[2025 Online Retro Event for Charity]] in this environment on GEMP in 2025. [[Joe Horbey]] heads the published Top 8.<ref name="pc-charity25" /> It is the only event known to have used it.
